request_summary: Redesign ACTIVITY_PROMPT and CHANGE_PROMPT_TMPL in recorder.py to maximise format compliance and output specificity for Qwen2-VL 2B

acceptance_criteria.description: ACTIVITY_PROMPT word count is ≤100 words — shorter than current ~138
ACTIVITY_PROMPT places the format line and a worked example FIRST — before any field rules
ACTIVITY_PROMPT explicitly instructs the model to read visible text on screen (title bar, tab title, URL bar) as primary source
ACTIVITY_PROMPT contains exactly 3 worked examples: code editor, browser, terminal
CHANGE_PROMPT_TMPL explicitly compares App and File/URL fields between {prev} and {curr} by naming those fields
CHANGE_PROMPT_TMPL lowers the threshold — fires when file, URL, or focused section changes, not only on full app/task switch
Both constants are plain string literals; CHANGE_PROMPT_TMPL retains {prev} and {curr} .format() placeholders

design_constraints: No UI changes — backend prompt constants only
Do not change the · separator character or three-field structure — activity_feed.py splits on ' · '
Max 3 rules in activity prompt — small models lose format compliance above this
out_of_scope: Changing activity_feed.py or any other file
risk_flags: Qwen2-VL 2B loses format compliance when given >3 rules — keep it minimal
The · character is U+00B7 MIDDLE DOT — must not be replaced with hyphen, pipe or ASCII dot
CHANGE_PROMPT_TMPL is text-only — cannot reference visual content
